run_flow: Read newest checkpoint cp_at; create one only if absent.
Write architecture and report; pass this cp_at to security scan checkpoint_id.
Call beyond_update_checkpoint(cp_at, cp_message) for the run summary, including unchanged or failed runs.
Call beyond_add_checkpoint to open the next window; response data.checkpoint.cp_at contains its ID.
content.actor_name: update_checkpoint changes only CP_MESSAGE. Original ACTOR_NAME and ACTOR_TYPE are preserved; actor_name is not an update input.
content.node_json: NODE_JSON stores one node object. For insert/update it is the final newData node; for delete it is the matching oldData node immediately before deletion. Keep old audit fields and DIFF_SOURCE unchanged for delete. NODE_VALUES is removed when opening projects and is not returned by MCP. Determine deletion only from ACTION=delete. No OLD_NODE_VALUES column is added.
content.missing_checkpoint: update_checkpoint returns an error without creating a row.

node_history_contract.delete_node_json: JSON serialization of that same one oldData object.
node_history_contract.producer_requirements: Every update must provide the matching complete oldData and newData row; every delete must provide complete oldData. Classification uses NODE_TYPE/NODE_ID identity, excluding GIT_STAGE as before.

content.consumer_rules: Use node_json for structured inspection when present. NODE_VALUES is no longer stored or returned. Determine insert/update/delete only from action. Delete node_json describes the deleted node immediately before deletion; it is not a live node or the interval starting snapshot. Do not restore a deleted object merely because its payload is nonempty. No OLD_NODE_VALUES is stored.

delete_example.note: Illustrative fields only: actual node_json preserves the full deleted oldData object, including audit fields and DIFF_SOURCE.
